description: The Hunting Horn's songs on the top screen (core/interface/horn_songs/): where the list goes and how its rows look. Places and sizes are in the top screen's pixels at the HUD's full size and the game's own 5:3 shape; the HUD size scales them about the top right corner, as the minimap. The list is flush with the screen's right edge, under the minimap; at full size its eight rows end above the item selector (y 191), which scales towards the bottom right corner, so every smaller HUD leaves more room; a smaller HUD scales the list less than the minimap (list_scale) so its rows stay readable (tests/interface/horn_songs).

minimap_gap.description: In screen pixels at every HUD size: from the minimap's bottom edge (the minimap is 128 x 128 pixels at the top right corner at full size, scaled with the HUD) to the list's top.

list_scale.description: The list's own scale at each HUD size (percent), about the top right corner: 1.0 is the row tuning below as it stands. The minimap scales with the HUD (0.7 at 70 %) but the list less, so its rows stay readable; at full size it is a little under 1 so its eight rows keep clear of the item selector (y 191) below the gap; between the sizes the scale is linear.

row.description: A row from the left: padding, the four notes' column (the first one played on the left, note_pitch apart, each note_size big: the picture's note is 10/16 of it wide), text_gap, the name's box (text_width, left-aligned), padding up to the screen's edge. Its bar is the whole row, height tall; a row starts pitch below the one above: with height = pitch the bars touch and the shown rows are one block.

font.description: The names' font size (no taller than a row's band) and the space between letters: the longest name of the five languages (its glyphs' real advances scaled by size / 14, no negative spacing so no letter overlaps another) fits text_width (tests/interface/horn_songs).

colours.description: RGBA. A row is idle, partial (the last notes played are its first ones) or full (its whole tune was just played): its name and its bar take that state's colour (the bars: a dark see-through block, a partial row a shade lighter, a full one gold); its notes tint the game's note pictures, a little darker while waiting, their own colours when lit (the notes played so far, or all of a full row).

group.description: The group's layer and draw priority: over the 3D scene and the hunters' names (0), under Damage Numbers (18), the target marker (19), every HUD panel (20 and up) and the talk windows (63).
